description: FastAPI router module for handling assignment and progress endpoints in a role-based learning management system, including assigning lessons, listing assignments, marking lessons complete, and retrieving progress metrics.

methods.name: assign_lesson
methods.description: Assigns a lesson to an employee by inserting a record into the 'assignments' table.

methods.name: list_assignments
methods.description: Retrieves all assignments for a specific employee.

methods.name: mark_complete
methods.description: Marks an assignment as completed by inserting or updating a record in the 'completions' table.

methods.name: get_progress
methods.description: Calculates and returns progress metrics for an employee, including assigned and completed lesson counts and completion percentage.
